_comment: Thresholds set from measurement, not from aspiration. Four runs against
the same build on a loaded box scored performance 99, 99, 95, 97 while
accessibility, best-practices and SEO returned 100 every time.
So the two kinds of score get two kinds of gate. The three stable
categories are held near where they are, because a drop there is a real
regression a human introduced. The performance score is a floor well
below the worst observed run: it is NOT a target, and passing it is not
evidence of anything. It exists to catch a catastrophe -- a render
blocking script, an unoptimised hero image -- on a shared runner whose
noise is larger than any change worth arguing about.
Read the reported numbers in the job summary for the real signal.
